headline: World Cup game delayed in Philadelphia due to thunderstorms, FIFA confirms
summary: The second half of the France vs. Iraq World Cup match was halted due to severe weather. FIFA protocols in the US mandate suspensions for lightning within an eight-mile radius.
details: France and Iraq players were left waiting in their dressing rooms at halftime after thunderstorms forced a delay to the start of the second half of their World Cup clash on Monday. A FIFA spokesperson confirmed the game would resume at least 30 minutes from when the halftime break started.

An advisory message on the scoreboard urged fans to exit the open seating area and seek shelter in the stadium. France was leading 1-0 after Kylian Mbappe scored his 15th World Cup goal in the 14th minute.

France coach Didier Deschamps noted the constantly changing weather updates, stating he had stopped updating players as conditions changed every 30 seconds. He emphasized the importance of a proper warm-up before resuming play.

World Cup matches in the United States can face lengthy delays because FIFA must comply with local lightning safety regulations. Under US protocols, play is suspended immediately if lightning is detected within an eight-mile (13-km) radius of a stadium.

Play can only resume after 30 minutes have passed without a further strike, and any new lightning detection resets the countdown. This means delays can stretch for several hours if thunderstorms persist, though FIFA has no fixed time limit for abandoning a match, assessing each situation on a case-by-case basis.

headline: 16 arrested in Rangamati as activities, including Awami League, are banned
summary: Authorities in Rangamati have arrested 16 individuals, including members of the Awami League, following a ban on certain activities in the area. The arrests aim to maintain order amidst the restrictions.
details: Sixteen individuals have been arrested in Rangamati, following a ban on certain activities in the area. Members of the Awami League are reportedly among those taken into custody.

The arrests were made to enforce the restrictions, though the specific nature of the banned activities was not immediately detailed by authorities. Further information is awaited regarding the circumstances leading to these measures.
